title: 2024 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: In a long line of people arranged left to right, the \(1013\)th person from the left is also the \(1010\)th person from the right. How many people are in the line?

solutions.text: There are \(1012\) people to the left of this spot and \(1009\) to the right. Add those two groups plus the person themselves: \(1012 + 1009 + 1 = 2022.\) Or, just as fast, the two positions overlap on one person, so \(1013 + 1010 - 1 = 2022.\) Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: There are \(1012\) people to the left of this person and \(1009\) to the right
Add the two counts, but do not count this one person twice
